itemList.description: Providing, supplying and fixing Eco laminates sheets 1.5 mm thick (Acrylic sheet) 8’0” X 4’0” (LA 8504/8502/etc.) for existing wall cladding, wall paneling using Duro bond 900 GM Adhesive gum as per direction of Engineer Incharge of the work. The rate includes cost of all material, labour, lead, lift and any other incidental charges required for the successful completion of work.

Providing and fixing Eco laminates (Acrylic sheet) of approved colour, type and thickness (LA 8504/8502/etc). Fixing P.V.C. 0.58 GTS HD reapers 8mm thickness using rowl plugs using 50 X 10 SS screws. Fixing Cardamom colour BWP 710 12mm thick 8’0” X 4’0” size plywood by using favicol, nails 14X1.5” WH (Zinc). Fixing the Eco laminates (LA 8504/8502/etc) over plywood sheet using Durobond 900 G.M. Adhesive as per direction of Engineer Incharge of the work. The rate includes cost of all material, labour, lead, lift and any other incidental charges required for the completion of work.
